# telnyx_whatsapp_message_templates (Data Source)

Lists whatsapp message templates, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_whatsapp_message_template`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_category` (String) One of `AUTHENTICATION`, `MARKETING`, `UTILITY`.
- `filter_search` (String)
- `filter_status` (String)
- `filter_waba_id` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `whatsapp_message_templates` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--whatsapp_message_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--whatsapp_message_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `whatsapp_message_templates`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String)
- `components` (List of String) Template components (header, body, footer, buttons) as submitted, including example values.
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `language` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `rejection_reason` (String)
- `status` (String) Current template status from Meta (e.g. PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, PAUSED, DISABLED). Additional statuses may be returned as Meta evolves the template lifecycle.
- `template_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `whatsapp_business_account` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--whatsapp_message_templates--whatsapp_business_account))

<a id="nestedatt--whatsapp_message_templates--whatsapp_business_account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `whatsapp_message_templates.whatsapp_business_account`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
